snippet.title: Restitched | Official Wardrobe Trailer
snippet.description:
The Restitched Wardrobe is a fully-fledged game mode, offering tons of customization! Style your Stuffy with head-to-toe cosmetics across various categories, then decorate with stampable graphics! 😍 

In the Wardrobe, you can also publish, browse, or download custom outfits from an integrated Steam Workshop menu... Sharing is caring! 🤩💖

🛠️ From gameplay to customization and level building, there's a whole world of creativity to unpack! Check out the full playlist for more.

---------------------------------------------------

⭐ Restitched on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361090/Restitched/

⭐ Find us on social media: 
https://linktr.ee/trixelcreative


⚠️ Note: This footage contains optional community-made Workshop downloads (from a pre-release playtest). Some outfits may resemble protected characters of which Trixel Creative is not affiliated with.
